cost_note.reading: the lexical channel is an inverted index whose per-document BM25 weights are entirely query-independent under the registered scoring form, so a query is a gather and a bincount; the index is built ONCE per snapshot and the per-query cost is measured here, not modelled
cost_note.reference_measured: multidim_recall costs 1.147 s per call over 11,514 facets and runs 2x per trajectory = 2.294 s per trajectory of pure control-plane CPU
cost_note.vectorization_prerequisite: the plan's engineering note stands and is UNCHANGED by this gate: the 1.147 s/call cost belongs to the EXISTING scalar content dimension, not to the new channel, and it is what must be vectorised before a 1,000-sample flight

registered_constants.lexical_similarity: bm25 / max_d bm25 (per query, order-preserving, bounded [0,1])

query_normalizations.Q-RAW: the direct-decode text verbatim -- exactly what the flight embedded
query_normalizations.Q-VAL: the same text minus the constant schema key tokens ['action', 'entities', 'filler', 'scenario', 'type']

registered_constants.tokenizer: lowercase, then r'[a-z0-9]+'; no stemming, no stoplist, no resource

scope: DEV-tier ITERATION design input. This gates a flight and is not one: no knob is changed, no arm is re-flown, no new sample is touched, no new gold surface is opened, and FINAL60 and test remain untouched.
